name: Iverron
summary: In Shadowglen, Iverron lies stricken by spider venom. His plight points to a growing corruption within Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Bitter Bite
sections.body: Webwood spiders bit Iverron beneath Shadowglen’s quiet canopies. Their venom left the young night elf unable to reach safety alone. Once, the spiders shared the glade in peace. Now they grow more aggressive.

sections.title: Desperate Remedies
sections.body: Iverron’s companions and local healers seek a cure with hyacinth mushrooms, moonpetal lilies, and webwood ichor. Together, these woodland ingredients make an antidote. His survival rests on how swiftly they can prepare it.

faq.answer: Iverron is a young night elf in Shadowglen, within Teldrassil. Webwood spiders bit him as he wandered the woodland, and he needs urgent aid to survive.
Aggressive webwood spiders bit Iverron in Shadowglen and poisoned him with debilitating venom.
An antidote made from hyacinth mushrooms, moonpetal lilies, and webwood ichor from the spiders cures Iverron.
You can find Iverron in Shadowglen, a secluded glade in Teldrassil where young night elves begin their training.
Iverron’s friend Dirania Silvershine asks for help gathering antidote ingredients. Then she asks that the antidote be brought back to him before it loses its potency.

faq.q: Why are the spiders in Shadowglen so hostile?
faq.answer: An unnatural malady spreading through Teldrassil has made Shadowglen’s spiders hostile. It warps normally reclusive beasts into violent predators.

angles.text: As a night elf taking your first steps outside Aldrassil, you can see in Iverron’s misfortune how quickly Teldrassil’s wilds are falling out of balance.
As a druid studying in Shadowglen, you can see Iverron’s poisoning as a sign of a deeper affliction gripping nature. The remedy draws on the glade’s flora and fauna.
As an herbalist, you can help preserve life by gathering Shadowglen’s plants quickly. Iverron’s survival depends on it.
